Implementation guides

Each MCP implementation has a dedicated guide for its content surface, application connection, API conventions and setup. These pages explain how the implementations differ; package READMEs and generated references remain the source for complete tool schemas and options.

  • InDesignLayout, documents, typography, tables, long documents and output.
  • IllustratorArtboards, vector artwork, paths, type, effects and export.
  • PhotoshopPixels, documents, layers, selections, adjustments and output.
  • After EffectsProjects, compositions, animation, effects and rendering.
  • Premiere ProProjects, sequences, timeline editing and UXP bridge setup.
  • Adobe MCP coordinatorCross-app workflows and child-server orchestration.
  • Blender MCPRust server, Blender add-on, local IPC and 3D workflows.
  • Shared coreCommon server infrastructure for contributors and integrators.
